meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

howto.what: 检测已安装的 OpenClaw，读取身份、凭据、定时任务与配置，并对话引导迁移到 NanoClaw v2，改动前先展示，凭据打码显示。
howto.when: 用户说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.note: 我会先检测你的 OpenClaw 安装。

howto.what_en: Detects an existing OpenClaw install, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration to NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying and masking credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

I'll guide you through it step by step.
